description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 $40 - $50/hourpay 
 
 Role Title:  Frontend Software Engineer
 Role Type : Contractor
 Location:  Remote
 
 We are seeking experienced Frontend Software Engineers to contribute to an AI-driven initiative focused on building and evaluating high-quality user interfaces. In this role, you will apply your frontend development expertise to help improve next-generation AI systems by creating accurate, production-quality UI implementations and providing domain-specific technical insights.
 No prior AI experience is required. Your knowledge of frontend engineering, responsive design, and modern web technologies will play a key role in helping AI models learn how to build visually polished, accessible, and high-performing web applications.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Translate detailed component specifications, design systems, and UI mockups into accurate, production-quality web interfaces.
 Build pixel-perfect, responsive user interface components using TypeScript , CSS3 , and modern frontend development practices.
 Ensure all implementations follow established design systems, accessibility standards, and responsive design principles.
 Collaborate effectively within a remote-first environment through clear technical documentation, code reviews, and constructive feedback.
 Identify and resolve inconsistencies or ambiguities in design specifications before implementation.
 Optimize frontend performance to deliver fast-loading, responsive, and seamless user experiences across browsers and devices.
 Contribute technical expertise to support the development and evaluation of advanced AI models for frontend engineering tasks.
 Required Qualifications
 3+ years of professional experience in frontend software development.
 Strong proficiency in TypeScript , CSS3 , HTML, and modern responsive web development.
 Demonstrated experience building pixel-perfect interfaces from design specifications, mockups, or screenshots.
 Experience working with component libraries, design systems, and reusable UI architectures.
 Strong understanding of responsive layouts, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility (WCAG), and frontend performance optimization.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
 Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in distributed, remote development environments.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience extending or maintaining enterprise design systems.
 Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks and component-driven development.
 Strong eye for visual detail and UI consistency.
 Experience collaborating with designers and cross-functional engineering teams.
 Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
 Engagement Details
 Fully remote opportunity with flexible working arrangements.
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on advanced AI and frontend engineering projects.
 Apply real-world frontend development expertise to improve AI-generated user interfaces and engineering workflows.
 Opportunities for continued engagement based on project needs and performance.
 Equal Opportunity
 We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants and offer reasonable accommodations throughout the application and engagement process upon request.
